editionLabel: Schmidt Spiele English rules, Johannes Schmidauer-König edition
firstPlayerRule: The last person to have visited Vienna takes the start card (clock) and begins the game.
clarifications: Players then choose their other start cards in counterclockwise order.
The start player rolls first; play proceeds clockwise.
In later rounds, whoever holds the start card begins.

sources.title: Vienna English rules

internalEvidence: Visually checked English pages 17 and 21 of the publisher-authored rulebook mirrored by GGnF. Page 17 names the last Vienna visitor, awards the clock start card, specifies counterclockwise start-card choice and clockwise turns, and says the start player rolls first. Page 21 says the clock holder starts the next round. Cover and credits identify the Schmidt Spiele game by Johannes Schmidauer-König, matching inventory BGG 171492, distinct from Queen Games' later Stefan Feld City Collection game BGG 368974.
